summary: Describes meta/runtime.yml keys: requires_ansible (PEP 440 specifier with prereleases truncated) and plugin_routing with redirect, deprecation and tombstone entries for moved or removed plugins.
questions: How do I declare which ansible-core versions my collection supports?
Will a prerelease like 2.11.0b1 satisfy requires_ansible >=2.11?
How do I deprecate or redirect a plugin in my collection?
What is a tombstone in runtime.yml?

answer_card.title: meta/runtime.yml: requires_ansible and plugin_routing
answer_card.answer_md:
- `requires_ansible`: e.g. `">=2.10,<2.11"`. It's a PEP 440 specifier, but prerelease segments are truncated, so 2.11.0b1 satisfies `>=2.11`.
- `plugin_routing`: keyed by plugin type, then name:
  - `redirect`: new location
  - `deprecation`: warning text plus removal version/date (add `redirect` too if moved)
  - `tombstone`: fatal error message and removal version/date for removed plugins
